modes.chapeau: From classic 5v5 to quick Fighting games, each mode changes the rules. Choose one to discover the details.

modes.ogDescription: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang game modes and what sets them apart.

heroes.chapeau: The {heros} heroes of the game and their {skins} skins, filterable by role and position. The {analyses} sheets marked “Analysis” also contain a commentary, builds and counters.

heroes.ogDescription: The {heros} heroes of Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, with their {skins} skins.

heroDetail.analyseTexte: The data for {nom} is up to date — it comes directly from the wiki. What's missing is the commentary: what the hero really does, his builds and his counters. This cannot be extracted, it is written.
heroDetail.contresIntro: Established on the winning rates of the game: the difference in points indicates how much the rate of {nom} varies against each opponent.
heroDetail.metaDescription: {nom}: {roles} from Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Position {lanes}, {skins} skins.

items.chapeau: The {n} items in the store. Click on an object to see the detail; filter by category or search directly for a statistic.
items.metaDescription: The {n} items in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang: statistics, unique effects, passives, recipes and prices, with their visuals.
items.ogDescription: The {n} game items, with stats, passives and recipes.

itemsListe.rechercher: Search for an item, stat, passive
itemsListe.choisir: Choose an item to see its stats, passive, and recipe.

emblems.chapeau: The real question is not what talents exist, but which ones to take for the role you play. Choose your emblem: the rest of the page is reorganized around it.
emblems.metaDescription: Which emblem, talent and combat spell to take depending on your role in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Choose your emblem, the page is organized around it.
emblems.ogDescription: What to take depending on your role: emblems, talents and combat spells.

draft.chapeau: Fill in what you see opposite, lane by lane. The tool suggests answers and says what justifies them. Add your own picks as you go: the suggestions adjust.
draft.note: Counters and synergies come from relationships brought up through play, not from an opinion. They do not cover all duels: a hero without a known counter in a composition is not necessarily a bad choice - he simply has nothing in particular to oppose.
draft.metaDescription: Inform the opposing composition: the tool suggests what to take on each lane, and explains why — counters, synergies and victory rates.
draft.ogDescription: What to take when faced with the composition opposite, and why.

compare.chapeau: Choose two heroes and read their strengths side by side: wiki ratings, win and ban rates reported by the game, roles and positions. The best value of each line is highlighted.
compare.metaDescription: Compare two heroes from Mobile Legends: Bang Bang side by side: offensive, resistance, effects, difficulty, win and ban rates, roles and positions.
compare.ogDescription: Two heroes compared side by side: ratings, win and ban rates, roles.

news.chapeau: In-depth articles rather than short ones: what's changing in the meta, why, and what to do about it.
news.metaDescription: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang meta analyses, background guides and patch readings, in French. Available in RSS feed.
news.ogDescription: Meta analyzes and in-depth guides, in French.

tierList.chapeau: This ranking is not an opinion: it is calculated from the win and ban rates reported by the game, and is redone on its own at each synchronization.
tierList.metaDescription: Tier list of Mobile Legends: Bang Bang calculated from the win and ban rates reported by the game. Recalculated at each synchronization, without opinion.
tierList.ogDescription: Ranking calculated from the game's win and ban rates.
tierList.scoreBold: win rate + a quarter of the ban rate
tierList.p2: Win rate measures what a hero produces once played. The ban rate measures what players fear: it catches heroes who are too strong to be left free, whose win rate is deceptively low because they are rarely available.
tierList.p3pre: Selection rate is not part of the calculation — it measures popularity, not power. It is only used to signal
tierList.p3post: the heroes played too little for their numbers to be stable.
tierList.tropPeu: Too little is involved for the rates to be reliable

patchNotes.chapeau: The content of recent updates is included here, section by section. Older patches remain listed, with a link to their original page.
patchNotes.metaDescription: The {n} patches for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Details of recent updates can be viewed directly here, without leaving the site.
patchNotes.ogDescription: The {n} patches of the game, with details of the most recent ones.
patchNotes.recenses: {n} patches listed · {m} available on the site · synchronizes the
patchNotes.analysesIntro: What the official notes don't say: the real effect of the changes in part.
patchNotes.anciens: Older patches are not included in full - their content would represent several megabytes for versions that no one plays anymore.

login.intro: Connect your game account using the official Moonton verification code. No password is required.
login.secu: The site never sees your password. It only receives a temporary token, stored in a secure cookie, which you delete when you log out.
login.metaDescription: Connect your Mobile Legends account by verification code, without password.

watch.chapeau: What the rest of the web publishes about the game: esports community and press, automatically brought together. Each entry returns to its publisher — nothing is copied here.
watch.metaTitre: Watch — MLBB news from the web
watch.metaDescription: The latest posts from the community and esports press on Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, collected automatically.
watch.ogDescription: Mobile Legends news from around the web, gathered automatically.
watch.aucune: No source responds at the moment. The page automatically reloads at the next collection.

classic.texte: Two teams of five, three lanes, one Nexus to destroy. The founding mode, without ranking issues: ideal for discovering a hero or warming up.

ranked.texte: The competitive line. Each victory earns stars and raises Warning to Mythical Glory, with bans and selection in draft from Epic.

brawl.texte: Single card has a lane, hero draws lots. Short and nervous games, without jungle or long return to base phase.

vs-ai.texte: Opponents controlled by AI, with adjustable difficulty. To test a build or tame a new hero without the pressure of ranking.

custom.texte: Create a tailor-made game: team composition, spectators, map and free parameters. The mode of tournaments and matches between friends.

arcade-mode.texte: A rotation of special and festive modes – Magic Hunt, Survival and other variants – offered for a limited time.

histoire.aucunRecit: The wiki does not yet publish a story for {nom}.

home.classementTitre: At the head of the patch

cartes.donneesTexte: Heroes, skins, items, patches and visuals are extracted from the wiki every week. A new hero appears here without anyone realizing it.
cartes.classementTitre: The ranking does not give an opinion
cartes.classementTexte: The tier list is calculated based on the win and ban rates reported by the game. The calculation rule is displayed on the page.
cartes.ecritTexte: Analyzes, builds and guides are written by hand. No extraction will tell why a hero is strong; This is where contributions count.
